Record Class Entry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.map.Entry
Record Components:
key - left side of the mapping, may be null for a mapping that answers an absent input
value - right side of the mapping
equivalence - correspondence between key and value, never null — defaults to Equivalence.EQUAL
keyDisplay - human-readable name of the key in its code system, or null
valueDisplay - human-readable name of the value in its code system, or null
public record Entry(String key, String value, Equivalence equivalence, String keyDisplay, String valueDisplay) extends Record
A single key/value-pair of a Mapping, qualified by the Equivalence that holds between the two, and optionally by the human-readable name of either side.

The two displays are informative: nothing looks a code up by its display, and no format requires them. They exist so that a mapping read from a source that carries them - a FHIR ConceptMap does, for both the source and the target code - keeps them. A caller building a Coding from a translation has one to put in it.

Both key and value are Strings.

Since:
6.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
